query.sql: SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['version'] AS version, Attributes['commit'] AS commit, Attributes['go_version'] AS go_version FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_build_info' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, version, commit, go_version ORDER BY deployment

SELECT ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'] AS deployment, Attributes['toolkit_kinds'] AS toolkits, Attributes['auth_methods'] AS auth, Attributes['tracing'] AS tracing, Attributes['metrics_exporter'] AS metrics, Attributes['sampler_ratio'] AS sampler FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'mcp_platform_config_info' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND {{fleet}} GROUP BY deployment, toolkits, auth, tracing, metrics, sampler ORDER BY deployment

SELECT k AS phase, toFloat64OrZero(v) AS ms FROM (SELECT LogAttributes AS a FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'platform initialized' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['mcp_platform.deployment.id'], $deployment) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) ARRAY JOIN mapKeys(a) AS k, mapValues(a) AS v WHERE startsWith(k, 'phase_') ORDER BY ms DESC
